speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Duodenal Atresia

The history of bilious vomiting starting within the first day of life, combined with the absence of meconium passage and a family history of intestinal obstruction, strongly suggests a congenital small bowel obstruction. The ultrasound and X-ray results I requested should confirm this; please let me know immediately if they show the classic "double bubble" sign.
